description: This file defines the PHP class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Image, which provides an HTML module for embedding images in XHTML 1.1. It includes functionality for setting up image elements with attributes such as src, alt, height, width, and longdesc, with configurable restrictions based on the provided configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Image
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule to provide image embedding functionality with configurable attributes and restrictions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the image element with configurable attributes such as src, alt, height, width, and longdesc, and sets attribute transformations based on configuration settings.
